text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During training, Yukino Bijin got injured, 
so I brought her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. It was careless of me...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Tearin' an ankle like this ain't nothin' 
at all! Come on, let's get back to 
trainin'!
choice_data_list: Let's play it safe and get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Tearin' an ankle like this ain't nothin' 
at all! Come on, let's get back to 
trainin'!
choice_data_list: Let's play it safe and get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh... But surely it'd be fine if I just 
run a little bit...!
choice_data_list: It definitely has to be okay.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If that's what you say, Trainer... I 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, once my injury heals, please let me 
make up for today's training too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, Yukino Bijin slumped her 
shoulders and headed back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, maybe I wasn't as okay as I 
thought... Guess that means I should just 
stay quiet and rest...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that guts alone aren't always 
enough, I lent Yukino Bijin a shoulder to 
lean on.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering how it'd turn out, but... 
I guess sheer willpower really can pull 
you through!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna run one more lap 
while I'm at it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Yukino Bijin carried out her 
training within a reasonable limit.
